# ui::elevation_z

Namespace-scope declarations of `ui::elevation_z` from the rendering headers.

The elevation (Z, in DIPs) of each Fluent surface class, which shadow_recipe() turns into a shadow. A caller with its own Z ([NavigationShell](../controls/navigation-shell.md#uinavigationshell)'s pane is 32, [Tabs](../controls/tabs.md#uitabs) control's overlay 16) can pass a raw float instead.

## Constants

| Name | Type | Value | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="layer"></span>`Layer` | `float` | `1.0f` | A layer surface; casts no shadow. |
| <span id="control"></span>`Control` | `float` | `2.0f` | A control at rest/hover (pressed drops to 1); casts none. |
| <span id="card"></span>`Card` | `float` | `8.0f` | A card. |
| <span id="tooltip"></span>`ToolTip` | `float` | `16.0f` | A tooltip. |
| <span id="flyout"></span>`Flyout` | `float` | `32.0f` | A flyout, menu or other light-dismiss popup. |
| <span id="dialog"></span>`Dialog` | `float` | `128.0f` | A dialog (and a window); the recipe clamps here. |
